summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running tests or committing. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges and now yields one Text with click spans last; Opacity merges blended color into the existing style to preserve metadata; new tests in tests/test_tabs.py and an appended clickable-range test in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py; docs/reference/tabs.md; sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css. No edit to the layout resolver: its Edge protocol already declares size, min_size, and fraction. Deviations/choices: bar position uses displayed-tab index so duplicate names place the underline correctly; click action quotes the name via repr because the action parser uses literal_eval; next/previous skip same-named duplicates; letter search only triggers on single-character keys; action_range_clicked and on_key are async. Known limitation: an empty label has zero width, which the resolver treats as flexible. All tests are unverified until run.
